No longer able to read the Heliosgyre after her mind was corrupted by Voidmatter, she serves the Solisylum by collecting data from the outside world now. |voiceEN = |voiceCN = |voiceJP = |voiceKR = }} {{Quote|Her closed eyes seem less like rest and more like a designed state.}} '''The Refiner''' is one of the [[Heliodic Six]] members and makes her first appearance in [[Ode to the Second Sunrise]]. After completing {{Quest|Ode to the Second Sunrise}}, The Refiner is freed from her duties and can be found at [[Atuja Camp]] at {{color|help|18:00 to 15:00}} ==Location== Heliodic Six Location - The Refiner.png ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} {{Dialogue Start}} ==Dialogue== :;'''The Refiner''' What's your name, cute one? :;'''Well-behaved Soliskin''' Chuuluu! :'''The Refiner:''' What's your name, cute one? :'''Well-behaved Soliskin:''' Chuuluu :'''The Refiner:''' Oh, "Sweetie" is your name? The one who named you must have had a sweet tooth, hmm? :'''Well-behaved Soliskin:''' Chuuluu, chuuluu... :{{DIcon}} Excuse me, are you one of the Heliodic Six? :'''The Refiner:''' Good day, Arbiter from the chronicles. Yes, I am Freamir. The Refiner, they call my seat. :'''The Refiner:''' For now, to my old work as a Shepherd I have returned. I also serve as liaison to the Solisylum. :{{DIcon}} What brings you here? :'''The Refiner:''' Now that the Heliogyre turns once more, the natural world's subtleties are important references for us in drafting new season laws. And these little creatures... are most sensitive to shifts in the environment. :'''The Refiner:''' So I am here noting their behavioral changes. A task for which a Shepherd's touch is best suited. :'''The Refiner:''' We convey to the Shaper things that the Solisylum readings cannot fully capture. {{Dialogue End}} ==Character Mentions== {{Character Mentions}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = The Refiner |1_zhs = 拨缕 |1_zht = 撥縷 |1_ja = 繕う者 |1_ko = 발루(the Refiner) |1_fr = La Raffineuse |1_1_de = Der Veredler |1_es = La Refinadora |1_th = ผู้เรียงร้อยอาณัติ |2_en = Freamir |2_zhs = |2_zht = |2_ja = |2_ko = |2_fr = |2_de = |2_es = |2_th = }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.0}}
